# Vendored animation libraries

- **GSAP 3.12.5** — `gsap.min.js`.
- **ScrollTrigger 3.12.5** — `ScrollTrigger.min.js`.

Source: <https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/>.

Self-hosted so the site does not depend on a CDN at runtime. The files keep
their upstream license headers; see <https://gsap.com/licensing/>.
